primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 候補名はエホザバドの語中に含まれるだけで、ザバドという独立人物は明記されない。

review.identityCheckJa: 12:21の「ヨザカル」と「エホザバド」の名前に、候補IDの「ザバド」が部分的に一致するだけです。独立したザバドという人物はこの節に現れません。
